"""Independent exact finite E4 controls for II-E finishing batch.
All objects are rebuilt from permutation/cube/Clifford definitions;
no prior proposal, verdict or expected certificate is imported.
"""
from itertools import permutations,combinations,product
from collections import Counter
import json
import sympy as s
Q=s.Rational
N=5
ident=tuple(range(N))
def parity(p):return -1 if sum(p[i]>p[j] for i in range(len(p)) for j in range(i+1,len(p)))%2 else 1
def mul(p,q):return tuple(p[q[j]] for j in range(N))
def inv(p):return tuple(p.index(j) for j in range(N))
def order(p):
 r=ident
 for k in range(1,61):
  r=mul(r,p)
  if r==ident:return k
 raise ValueError
G=sorted(p for p in permutations(range(N)) if parity(p)==1);gix={p:i for i,p in enumerate(G)}
assert len(G)==60
ords={p:order(p) for p in G};assert Counter(ords.values())=={1:1,2:15,3:20,5:24}
pairs=list(combinations(range(N),2));pairsset=[frozenset(v) for v in pairs]
Ap=s.Matrix(10,10,lambda i,j:int(pairsset[i].isdisjoint(pairsset[j])))
edges=[(i,j) for i,j in combinations(range(10),2) if Ap[i,j]]
assert len(edges)==15
# Exact Petersen matching/edge-color obstruction and positive 4-color witness.
matchings=[]
for comb in combinations(edges,5):
 if len({i for e in comb for i in e})==10:matchings.append(comb)
assert len(matchings)==6
cycle_types=[]
for mm in matchings:
 rem=[e for e in edges if e not in mm];adj={i:[] for i in range(10)}
 for i,j in rem:adj[i].append(j);adj[j].append(i)
 unseen=set(range(10));lens=[]
 while unseen:
  todo=[unseen.pop()];comp=set(todo)
  while todo:
   u=todo.pop()
   for v in adj[u]:
    if v in unseen:unseen.remove(v);comp.add(v);todo.append(v)
  lens.append(len(comp))
 assert sorted(lens)==[5,5];cycle_types.append(lens)
colors={}
def color(k):
 if k==len(edges):return True
 e=edges[k];blocked={colors[f] for f in colors if set(e)&set(f)}
 for c in range(4):
  if c not in blocked:
   colors[e]=c
   if color(k+1):return True
   del colors[e]
 return False

def lie_dim(seed):

   basis.append(M);columns=columns.row_join(v);return True

   if add(A*B-B*A):changed=True

 ((2/s.sqrt(3))*qv).row_join(Q(8,9)*s.eye(4)+Q(4,9)*qv*qv.T).row_join((4*s.sqrt(6)/9)*Wq.T)).col_join(
 s.zeros(6,1).row_join((4*s.sqrt(6)/9)*Wq).row_join(s.eye(6)+Hq/2))

  poly=s.Poly(s.expand(part).subs(qs[3]**2,1-sum(z*z for z in qs[:3])),*qs)

"""Independent exact A5/Petersen calculations for Paper II-E finishing batch.
Objects are constructed from permutation and matrix definitions, not old
certificate outcomes. Binary rows are represented by duplicating A5 rows.
"""
import sympy as s
from itertools import permutations,combinations
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import json
checks=[]
def ck(n,c,r):
 if not bool(c):raise AssertionError(n)
 checks.append({'check':n,'passed':True,'result':r})
def parity(p):return sum(p[i]>p[j] for i in range(5) for j in range(i+1,5))%2
def mul(a,b):return tuple(a[b[i]] for i in range(5))
def inv(a):return tuple(a.index(i) for i in range(5))
e=tuple(range(5));G=[p for p in permutations(range(5)) if not parity(p)];gi={g:i for i,g in enumerate(G)}
def order(g):
 h=e
 for n in range(1,7):
  h=mul(h,g)
  if h==e:return n
 raise ValueError(g)
orders=[order(g) for g in G]
pairs=list(combinations(range(5),2));ps=[set(a) for a in pairs]
A=s.Matrix([[int(not(a&b)) for b in ps] for a in ps]);I10=s.eye(10);J10=s.ones(10)
ck('Petersen adjacency identity',A*A==2*I10-A+J10 and A.eigenvals()=={3:1,1:5,-2:4},'spectrum 3^1,1^5,(-2)^4')
edges=[(i,j) for i in range(10) for j in range(i+1,10) if A[i,j]]
for a in range(10):
 stab=[g for g in G if {g[i] for i in pairs[a]}==ps[a]]
 nei=[j for j in range(10) if A[a,j]]
 actions={tuple(nei.index(pairs.index(tuple(sorted(g[i] for i in pairs[j])))) for j in nei) for g in stab}
 ck('Petersen local S3 stabilizer '+str(a),len(stab)==6 and len(actions)==6,{'stabilizer':6,'faithful_neighbor_actions':6})
matchings=[]
def match(unused,chosen):
 if not unused:matchings.append(chosen);return
 a=min(unused)
 for b in sorted(unused):
  if b!=a and A[a,b]:match(unused-{a,b},chosen+[(min(a,b),max(a,b))])
match(set(range(10)),[])
def component_sizes(es):
 adj={i:set() for i in range(10)}
 for a,b in es:adj[a].add(b);adj[b].add(a)
 left=set(range(10));sizes=[]
 while left:
  seen={min(left)};todo=list(seen)
  while todo:
   x=todo.pop()
   for y in adj[x]-seen:seen.add(y);todo.append(y)
  sizes.append(len(seen));left-=seen
 return sorted(sizes)

   colors[(a,b)]=c
   if coloring(k+1):return True
   colors.pop((a,b))
 return False
ck('Petersen has proper four-edge coloring',coloring(0),{'edge_colors':[colors[x] for x in edges]})

# Relative-order incidence Gram matrices on the projective 60 points.

Mk={k:s.Matrix([[({2:15,3:10,5:6}[k] if i==j else int(rel[i][j]==k)) for j in range(60)] for i in range(60)]) for k in [2,3,5]}

P5=(Mk[2]-Mk[3])/12;P4=(Mk[3]-Mk[5])/15

cosets={frozenset(mul(g,h) for h in H) for H in cyclic3 for g in G}
U={g for g in G if order(g) in [1,2,3]};cores=[{g for g in G if g[i]==i} for i in range(5)]
L70=[C for C in cosets if any(C<=H for H in cores)];L80=[C for C in cosets if C<=U]
ul=sorted(U);R70=s.Matrix([[int(g in C) for C in L70] for g in ul]);R80=s.Matrix([[int(g in C) for C in L80] for g in ul])

 vals={Pi[2*i,2*i] for i in range(60) if orders[i]==n};lev[n]=[str(v) for v in vals]

def lift(S):return ((A+S).row_join(A-S)).col_join((A-S).row_join(A+S))/2
